hero.label: Security
hero.title: Your Data. Your Control.
hero.desc: No big-tech cloud dependencies. No centralized data honeypots. Infrastructure built from the ground up to minimize what can go wrong.

features.title: Independent Infrastructure
features.text: We don't rent space on AWS, Google, or Azure. Your sensitive data never passes through big-tech systems that mine, profile, or aggregate user information.

features.title: Isolated by Design
features.text: Each operator's data lives in its own encrypted store. A breach elsewhere can't cascade to you. Smaller attack surface means fewer things that can go wrong.

features.title: No Single Point of Failure
features.text: Critical operations require multiple independent approvers. No single person can unilaterally access data or make system changes.

features.title: Signed Everywhere
features.text: Every state-changing operation requires Solana Ed25519 wallet signature. On-chain verification with tamper-evident audit trail.

info_blocks.title: Why This Matters
paragraphs: Most platforms store everyone's data in one giant database on rented cloud infrastructure. When that database gets breached, everyone's exposed at once.
items: Dedicated systems: Purpose-built infrastructure we control, not shared cloud resources
Data isolation: Your operation's data is walled off from every other operation
Encrypted everything: Data encrypted at rest and in transit with keys we rotate regularly
Multi-party controls: Sensitive operations require approval from multiple independent keyholders
Minimal footprint: We collect only what's legally required — less data stored means less data at risk

info_blocks.title: Data & Storage
paragraphs: All data is stored in encrypted SQLite databases at rest. Envelope-encrypted with per-operator wallet-anchored keyboxes. No commingling of data between operators.

info_blocks.title: Incident Response
paragraphs: Documented incident response procedures with 24/7 monitoring. Security incidents are communicated transparently to affected parties within regulatory timeframes.
